{{Top|leg}}
'''Kulma Narrows''' was an inhabited area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of Kulma Narrows in the final product. The location was later made [[canon]]ical in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']].
